title: Senior Engineering Manager- Ubuntu
description:

Join to apply for the Senior Engineering Manager- Ubuntu role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Engineering Manager to lead the engineering team that delivers the essential components of Ubuntu - our system startup, compilers, language runtimes and toolchains, as well as networking and storage config and management. This is a fast-paced, problem-solving, highly technical role operating at the core of Linux server systems.
As an Engineering Manager on the Foundations team, you will be at the heart of driving Ubuntu. Working at the unique intersection of the open source ecosystem, and enterprise technologists.
In this pivotal position, you'll lead and inspire your team of engineers, to take Ubuntu to new heights. We are looking for someone with a deep understanding of Linux and Ubuntu with a passion for exceptional leadership. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery and drive your team on strategy and execution.
Location: Globally remote
The role entails

  • Lead and grow a team of distributed engineers
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles through active and hands on leadership
  • Be responsible for planning, estimation and execution
  • Work with product management to define the vision and strategy for Ubuntu
  • Collaborate with cross-functional leadership teams
  • Drive the advancement and adoption of the latest software development practices
  • Design, embrace and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Engage with other teams at Canonical to ensure alignment on product architecture and roadmaps
  • Work from home while meeting in person for company sprints. Sprints are typically twice a year for 1-2 weeks.
What we are looking for in you
  • You have worked extensively with Linux distributions, and are experienced with packaging technologies (e.g. deb, rpm, other)
  • You have demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers
  • High quality software engineering knowledge in one or more of: Linux system architecture, boot process, Java/GCC/Python/Rust/Go toolchains, ARM and/or RISC-V
  • Engagement with open source communities and processes
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Para compor o quadro de profissionais para atender ao Hospital da Mulher Mariska Ribeiro. Na função de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho, desempenhando as seguintes funções:Orientar os funcionários do Hospital quanto aos aspectos técnicos e conceituais da segurança do trabalho nas questões de meio ambiente e qualidade, buscando o comprometimento de todos com a prevenção de acidentes de acordo com programas e políticas da instituição. Realizar inspeções de segurança junto às áreas, visando identificar riscos e orientando as medidas adequadas de redução e controle. Elaborar os procedimentos referentes à segurança do trabalho. Manter atualizadas as documentações/informações pertinentes ao segmento de segurança do trabalho dentro dos critérios padronizados para garantir a rastreabilidade dos fatos. Orientar a CIPA, Comissão do PGRSS, Equipe de Brigada de Incêndio entre outras, orientando quanto aos aspectos técnicos e conceituais da Segurança do Trabalho, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das suas atividades. Elaborar relatórios técnicos e estatísticos relacionados a segurança do trabalho, emitindo pareceres e sugestões de melhoria. Atuar em situações de emergência, colaborando para o seu controle, visando minimizar sua consequência. Participar de perícias na empresa, orientando as áreas quanto aos aspectos técnicos de segurança do trabalho. Participar da elaboração de estudos de Análise de Riscos, orientando quanto a aplicação de metodologias especificas. Investigar, analisar acidentes de trabalho e recomendar medidas de prevenção e controle. Distribuir os EPI’ s adequados dentro de cada função, visando proteger os trabalhadores dos riscos. REQUISITOS BÁSICOS PARA O CARGO Curso de Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho. Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função. Convênio com faculdade. Convênio com o SESC. Vale transporte. Plano odontológico. Auxílio Creche. Plano de saúde. Competências Individuais:Organização. Ética. Atenção. Proatividade. Iniciativa Etapas do processo seletivo:Questionário de pré-seleção, questionário de triagem, testagem técnica, avaliação curricular, entrevista com RH/Coordenação, entrega de documentos e exame admissional (todas as etapas são eliminatórias). description:
Engenheiro Eletricista Master (VAGA Extensiva para Pessoas com Deficiência)

Descrição
Somos a Concremat , uma plataforma de integração do grupo CCCC , que conecta o Brasil e a América Latina a uma rede global de especialistas. Mais do que fornecer soluções técnicas de engenharia, somos protagonistas na construção e viabilização de grandes projetos, sempre em parceria com nossas empresas-irmãs. Nosso propósito é claro: criar um futuro compartilhado, pautado no crescimento sustentável e na colaboração entre mercados, pessoas e tecnologias.
Atuamos em 15 países e mais de 200 localidades , ampliando constantemente nossa presença e impacto. Com uma abordagem que une inovação e experiência, proporcionamos soluções eficientes e integradas para os desafios da engenharia e infraestrutura. Nosso compromisso é fortalecer o desenvolvimento regional, promovendo conexões estratégicas entre diferentes mercados e culturas, sempre com foco na excelência e na responsabilidade socioambiental.
Se você busca desafios globais, inovação contínua e um ambiente colaborativo, a Concremat é o lugar certo para você. Aqui, cada profissional faz parte de um ecossistema que transforma realidades e impulsiona o futuro. Venha construir esse legado conosco!
Vem ser Concremat!
Estamos em busca de pessoas para atuar como Engenheiro Eletricista Master
Requisitos da Vaga

  • Pacote Office, especialmente Excel.
  • AutoCAD
  • Mínimo de 10 anos de formação em Engenharia Elétrica;
  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento e gestão de projetos industriais;
  • Atuação comprovada em ambientes industriais, com foco em projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Vivência prática em atividades de implantação, comissionamento e acompanhamento de obras técnicas;
  • Experiência na interface com empresas projetistas e fornecedores, acompanhando o ciclo completo de engenharia e implantação.
Atribuições e Responsabilidades
  • Estabelecer e manter comunicação com clientes internos para definição de escopos, alinhamento de expectativas e atualização do progresso dos projetos;
  • Acompanhar e garantir a qualidade dos serviços prestados pelas projetistas contratadas nas disciplinas de Elétrica, Instrumentação, Telecomunicações e Automação;
  • Realizar análise técnica, comentários e aprovação de documentação técnica, assegurando conformidade com normas nacionais, padrões internos e melhores práticas de engenharia;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica para contratação de serviços de engenharia, aquisição de materiais e serviços de implantação;
  • Gerenciar a interface entre a Engenharia e as empresas contratadas, estabelecendo cronogramas realistas e acompanhando o progresso dos escopos contratados;
  • Garantir a rastreabilidade de versões e alterações em projetos, com registro e aprovação conforme procedimentos do cliente;
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, os processos de execução, comissionamento, startup e operação assistida durante a implantação da obra.
Diferenciais: Experiência prévia em grandes projetos nos setores de Mineração, Portuário, Siderurgia, Celulose e Papel, ou Petroquímico;
  • Formação complementar ou treinamentos técnicos em Automação Industrial;
  • Conhecimento prático de normas técnicas brasileiras (NBR, NR), internacionais (IEC, IEEE), padrões de qualidade e melhores práticas de engenharia aplicada;
  • Familiaridade com processos de contratação, compras técnicas e acompanhamento de obras;
  • Noções de sistemas de gestão de engenharia e de versionamento de documentação técnica.
Local de Trabalho : Mangaratiba / RJ,
Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido
A Concremat acredita que a diversidade impulsiona a inovação e melhora nossos produtos e serviços. Promover a equidade e a inclusão gera novas ideias e contribui para uma sociedade mais justa. Nosso compromisso com as pessoas reflete diretamente na satisfação dos colaboradores, resultando em uma nota de 4,3 no Glassdoor .
Buscamos criar um ambiente onde todos possam ser autênticos, valorizados por seu talento e potencial. Por isso, incentivamos candidaturas de diferentes gêneros, raças, religiões, idades, orientações sexuais, nacionalidades e pessoas com deficiência.
Se você acredita no seu potencial, candidate-se, mesmo que não atenda a todos os requisitos. Queremos talentos dispostos a crescer com a gente!

description:
Técnico(a) Especialista de Laboratório IV

Receber amostras via sistema pneumático ou em mãos garantindo a sua correta identificação e rastreabilidade;
Preparar as amostras com máquinas automáticas e / ou manuais de acordo com os procedimentos operacionais;
Realizar análises químicas do aços, gusas, escórias e matérias-primas no Laboratório utilizando técnicas de Espectrometria ótica, Fluorescência de raio x e combustão direta de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos;
Realizar análises de radionuclídeos em amostras de aço;
Avaliar os resultados encontrados nas análises e enviá-los por meio do sistema automático;
Garantir o bom funcionamento das máquinas e equipamentos do laboratório, relatando e evidenciando todas as não conformidades dos mesmos;
Lançar e acompanhar o correto preenchimento das Cartas Controles, tomando as ações e tratativas necessárias conforme procedimentos estabelecidos;
Zelar pela conformidade dos ambientes, materiais, insumos críticos e bens sob sua responsabilidade.
Consolidar e aplicar os resultados de análise química para as corridas produzidas, utilizando o sistema pertinente, visando a geração dos certificados de qualidade das placas de aço produzidas na empresa;
Realizar aberturas de notas para manutenção dos equipamentos via sistema pertinente e tratativas conforme procedimento, visando o bom funcionamento das máquinas e equipamentos do laboratório Realizar intervenções, ajustes e correções em metodologias implementadas;
Dar suporte ao processo na realização de estudos estatísticos, com análise dos resultados e ações caso necessário;
Auxiliar na elaboração e implementação de métodos analíticos, utilizando normas técnicas;
Auxiliar nas avaliações de solicitações de novas demandas de aço, análises de falhas operacionais e desvios de qualidade;
Cumprir as práticas de laboratório de acordo com as normas ISO 17025 e 9001

  • Formação técnica em química e/ou áreas correlacionadas conclusas.
  • Experiência nas atividades descritas.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em regime de turno.
  • Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz - Rio de Janeiro - RJ

title: Senior Director - Stills Finance - South Zone
description:
A successful Stills Finance Sr Director is a business partner who co-leads the LatAm Stills strategy, maximizes System’s value through an integrated understanding of the business, and enhances people’s experience.

The position requires a solid understanding of P&L dynamics, Financial Modeling, Value Chain Analysis, Financial Planning, Business Intelligence, and ROI analysis.

Data-driven with strong analytical skills and effective communication are essential for fulfilling these responsibilities. The ideal candidate will support key strategic and transformational initiatives to accelerate Stills business growth in Brazil and South Cone while managing core FP&A processes.

The Sr Director will foster close collaboration with bottlers in Brazil and South Cone to align business opportunities and manage various business models related to the Stills categories. This role serves as the primary contact for five Joint Ventures and represents KO in their Financial Committees.

Why join Coca-Cola Latin America?

We are the fastest-growing large consumer goods company in Latin America. We focus on our people, collaborating with our diverse network of bottling partners, returning water to communities, and empowering employees to challenge the status quo, make bold recommendations, experiment, and grow together.

Position Overview:

Location: primarily Brazil; secondary locations: Argentina/Chile. No relocation assistance provided.

Focus, Scope & Impact:

  • Strengthen franchise relationships with Brazilian and South Cone bottlers and manage the complexities of the five Joint Ventures.

  • Support business transformation initiatives in collaboration with KO Stills Leadership and Bottler teams.

  • Partner with Category teams (Marketing, Operations, Finance, etc.) to accelerate portfolio opportunities for the Stills Business.

  • Manage the Stills Business alongside GMs by providing performance insights, assessing risks and opportunities, supporting financial valuations, and working on projections like LRP, Business Plan, and Rolling Estimates.

  • Enhance team members' experience within the Stills Finance team.

Functional activities include:

  • Modeling leadership according to the "Leadership in the Network" framework.

  • Providing a holistic understanding of business performance within the franchise.

  • Applying a fact-based, analytical, strategic approach to cross-franchise collaboration.

  • Deliver core financial strategies, practices, and solutions to sustainably grow business profitability.

  • Serve as a role model and contribute to team development.

Required work experience:

  • 10+ years of leadership experience in Finance, including areas like Commercial Finance, Business Partnering, Category/Market Finance, Analysis, and Business Development.

  • >8 years of experience in Massive Consumption Companies, with a deep understanding of production, sales, and distribution processes.

  • Proficiency in Financial Modeling and Valuation, with the ability to build models from scratch to support decision-making.

  • Experience in Business Intelligence, designing processes and tools to convert raw data into actionable insights.

  • Understanding of profitability dynamics and ability to anticipate impacts of strategies.

  • Knowledge of bottling business dynamics is a plus but not required.

Core mastery areas include:

  • Influence and communication skills.

  • Financial modeling and presentation skills.

  • Understanding of production, selling, and distribution processes.

  • Profitability management (P&L).

  • Analytical thinking.

Communication focus areas:

  • Leadership and team management within the franchise.

  • Management of local bottler teams (finance, commercial, etc.).

  • Financial oversight of JV teams.

  • Platform services.

Languages:

Fluent in Portuguese and Spanish and/or English.

Skills include: Value Chain, Financial Modeling, Economics, Budgeting, GAAP, Group Problem Solving, Microsoft Office, Forecasting, Communication, Decision Making, Internal Auditing, Teamwork, Financial Analysis, Financial Report Preparation.

Work is primarily sedentary; exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move object

Job Description
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced CFD Engineer to join our innovative engineering team at ABS Consulting. This role is critical in advancing our computational fluid dynamics (CFD) capabilities, driving the development of cutting-edge simulations to optimize product performance and efficiency across various applications.
What You Will Do

  • Lead the development and implementation of CFD methodologies to analyze complex fluid flow, heat transfer, and chemical reactions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall engineering goals.
  • Design and execute simulation plans, including grid generation, model setup, and validation against experimental data.
  • Utilize advanced post-processing techniques to analyze simulation results, identifying key insights and communicating findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Stay current with industry trends and advancements in CFD technology, integrating new tools and methodologies into the engineering workflow.
  • Performs advanced Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) modeling for quantitative risk analysis, including Fire and Explosion analysis, Gas Detectors allocation, Flame Detection Allocation, Exhaust and Vent dispersion, Smoke and Gas Dispersion, Flare Radiation Analysis, and Helideck Turbulence Analysis
  • Assists qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Suports Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA) to ensure compliance with safety standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Implements and maintains ABS Quality System requirements relative to responsibilities after undergoing ABS Quality System training.
  • Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, and responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience:
  • Master’s in chemical, mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field with a strong emphasis on fluid dynamics and experience on O&G projects.
  • Experience in CFD analysis, with proficiency in industry-standard software such as FLACS, KFX, CFX , ANSYS Fluent, OpenFOAM, or COMSOL.
  • Solid understanding of turbulence modeling, heat transfer, and multiphase flow dynamics.
  • Experience in qualitative risk analysis (e.g., HAZOP, HAZID) and vulnerability analysis.
  • Experience in Quantitative Risk Analysis (QRA).
  • Familiarity with Process Safety Management (PSM) principles.
  • Knowledge of Brazilian regulations (e.g., Petrobras Safety Guidelines, ANP, NRs) is a plus.
  • Professional or chartered engineering license
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems (i.e., the competence to demonstrate complex problem-solving skills).
  • Good command of the English language with the ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Expertise in computational fluid dynamics simulation and modeling techniques.
  • Proficiency in software tools for mesh generation, simulation, and post-processing.
  • Understanding of numerical methods and algorithms used in CFD.
  • Critical thinking and problem-solving capacity.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Ability to handle fast-paced, high-demand environments with strong stress management skills.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to obtain working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.
It Would Be Nice If You Have:
  • Experience in applying CFD to aerospace, automotive, or energy systems.
  • Experience in scripting or programming languages (Python, MATLAB) to automate processes and enhance simulation capabilities.
  • Familiarity with high-performance computing (HPC) environments and parallel processing techniques.
  • Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals or conference proceedings.

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.
We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

What we are looking for

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure Pipelines, incorporating security and performance testing
  • Expertise in Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with Datadog strongly preferred, including real-time alerting and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with Hub-and-Spoke network architecture and cloud security principles
  • Strong database administration experience with Azure SQL Server, including cloud-based backup, replication, and high-availability strategies. Experience with the Hyperscale service tier is a strong plus.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, incident management, and high-availability architectures
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, including security compliance, role-based access control, and vulnerability management
  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.
  • Ability to thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced remote work environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience supporting a remote team
  • Azure and/or Security certification(s) a plus

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications
Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.
You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote #J-18808-Ljbffr

The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat’s operational and technical teams.
Work Location

Duties and Responsibilities
Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat is starting a project with the municipality of Congonhas, Minas Gerais, in cooperation with the Municipal Planning and Management Department. This project aims to revise the Master Plan and develop the city's Mobility Plan. To achieve the proposed objective, the "Horizontes Congonhas" project is designed to strengthen public capacity and promote a culture of transparent decision-making based on data and information. This will be achieved through diagnostics, analysis, training and the drafting of plans. The Master Plan and the Mobility Plan wi ll be drawn up with the participation of society, configuring them as social pacts that take into account its interpretation of the strengths, potential and challenges of the city's spaces, seeking to improve the population's quality of life. To properly implement the project, a Data Analyst is required. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Data Analyst reports to the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Data Analyst will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a. Assist in the elaboration and calculation of variables, indicators and other data and information. b. Extract, process, and analyse data from public databases and statistics - such as those produced by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics and other organizations – and present them in various formats (tables, graphs, charts). c. Elaborate and/or support the creation of georeferenced information. d. Revise all documents produced related to spatial data and information. e. Participate and organize capacity building activities for UN-Habitat and government staff working in the implementation of UN-Habitat’s projects in Brazil. f. Provide appropriate technical support to implement activities related to collection, production, analysis and management of data, information and urban indicators and support any other studies and research. g. Provide information for the systematization and exchange of successful practices and experiences with other offices in the region and with headquarters divisions. h. Provide inputs for the identification of project risks. i. Document and maintain an orderly and accessible information file related to all activities undertaken. j. Be responsible for the delivery according to deadlines for each task and conduct administrative and management activities to ensure that projects meet the objectives in terms of deadlines, budget and quality. k. Document expert group meetings, training events and other activities related to the planning, development and implementation of ongoing and new projects. l. Perform other duties which may be requested by the supervisors. m. Participate in missions as requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Data Analyst will support the implementation of the project. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance, upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office and OiC for Southern Cone Office of monthly activities’ report.
Qualifications/special Skills
Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in social sciences, Architecture and Urbanism, Geography, Economics, or related Fields is required. Postgraduate degree (Lato Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Public Policy, Sociology, Political Science, Geography, Economics, Urban Studies, Statistics, or related fields is required, or four (4) additional years of experience relevant to the position, in addition to the requirement. Work experience:
  • Minimum five (5) five years of progressively responsible experience in project/programme management on urban related themes.
  • Professional and academic experiences on themes related to data analysis, reports and information for public policy, data visualization, data collection, processing and analysis are required.
  • Professional experience in the development of Master Plans and/or Mobility Plans is desired.
  • Experience related to UN and/or any other international agency is an asset. Skills:
  • Proficiency in Office Package (MS Word, Excel, Powerpoint and Outlook) is required.
  • Proficiency in geographic information system (GIS) software such as QGIS or ArcGIS is required.
  • Good handling of software, online platforms and other tools for data visualization is desirable.
  • Good command of programming languages such as R or Python is desirable.
  • Good knowledge on project management methodologies is desirable. Competencies
  • Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
  • Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
  • Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
  • The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
  • The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
  • The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
  • The person will prepare databases related to the project running.

  • The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
  • The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
  • English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
  • For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese and English is required. Working knowledge of Spanish is desired.

This is a general selection process for all seniority levels, to join teams that focus on open source networking software at Canonical. Apply here if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking at any level - from the Linux kernel IP or eBPF and bridge constructs, to overlay SDN networking like OVS and OVN, to router, switch and radio access technologies such as SoNIC, FRR and DENT, all the way up to telco MANO and 5G Core solutions.
We work with networking silicon providers to optimise Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data centre networking, from bare metal through virt, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.
If you have a passion for networking technologies, deep familiarity with Linux networking and awareness of open source community best practices, then you will enjoy our software-defined networking role at Canonical. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation and performance in your work.
At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, OpenStack, LXD, MAAS and MicroK8s across a broad range of devices and use cases.
These roles include:

  • Kernel Networking Software Engineer
  • OVN Software Engineer
  • SmartNIC Software Engineer
  • Top-of-Rack (ToR) Software Engineer
  • SoNIC or DENT Software Engineer
  • Telco Software Engineer
  • Kubernetes Software Engineer
Location: we have networking software engineering roles in every time zone
What your day will look like
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available
  • Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers
  • Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the latest hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Contribute to shape innovative product strategies
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organisation
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data centre architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Work from home, with global travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Knowledge of networking: architecture, design, and protocols
  • Deep understanding of Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each
Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring
  • Familiarity with existing open source networking technologies - kernel (including eBPF, AF_XDP), OVS, OVN, SoNIC, DENT, Switchdev, DPDK, SPDK, 5G 3GPP, ONF stack, iwd, NetworkManager, etc.
  • Familiarity with data path hardware acceleration protocols and interfaces, such as RDMA, RoCE, iWARP, NVMe, SR-IOV
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, and RISC-V
  • Experience in complex IP network engineering and implementation
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, e.g., QEMU, KVM, etc.
  • Previous contribution to open source projects and community involvement
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Cloud-native Network Functions, and Container Network Interface plugins
  • Performance engineering and security experience
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job Title
Sr. Manager, Business Information Security Officer (BISO)
Job Description
Concentrix Corporation is seeking a Brazil Business Information Security Officer to join the Global Security team reporting to the CNX MET GEO Business Information Security Officer – Insider Risk and Compliance team.
The Brazil Business Information Security Officer (BISO) focuses on proactively identifying security and compliance issues/risks to business operation processes in various accounts, drives in executing the controls to deter, detect and mitigate security and insider risks - including establishing capability and mechanisms to monitor and audit information and data protection of both Concentrix and clients as well as compliance level of each process and relevant control item as deployed in the operational environment, The country BISO drives proactively to enhance the fraud and compliance prevention culture and risk-free environment in Concentrix as well as identifies issues that would include but not limited to physical and logical security, data privacy, KPI, CSAT, inbound/outbound calls manipulation, information leakage, etc. impacting business. Typical activities include but are not limited to Risk Management – risk identification, risk assessments, support in development of risk action plans, risk closures, supporting investigations - case documentation, written first-hand reports, involve in-person or remote interview of persons of interest and working outside normal business hours etc., Governance and metrics, Executive presentations, Collaboration with all teams/ departments. Achieves results through direct interaction as well as influencing other internal groups or persons to achieve results.
Qualifications

  • 7 to 10 years of experience working in risk and compliance management, internal security controls, internal/external security assessment or audit, internal or cyber incident investigations.
Advanced English Level is a MUST, Spanish will be a plus
  • Bachelor's/ Masters’ Degree in Information Technology or relevant areas.
  • CISA certified or willing/able to certify within 12 months of employment.
  • Experience in the BPO industry working in quality, security compliance or delivery strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of BPO Business Operation and CRM services delivery processes.
  • Understanding fraud, process non-compliance and incident investigations as well as various risks in the BPO industry.
  • Ability to identify performance and opportunity gaps.
  • Detail oriented with excellent analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to effectively communicate findings to senior team members with appropriate recommendation and action plan raised to address the gaps in an effective & efficient manner.
BISO Responsibilities
  • Drive the highest Integrity and Ethical standards across the staff and the accounts in scope.
  • Provide governance to operations management team and Quality Assurance team for effective and efficient surveillance and monitoring towards pro-active security and business process non-compliance issue identification.
  • Collaborate with respective supporting functions/departments (IT, HR, Facility, Legal, DPO, etc.) to address relevant security issues/risks.
  • Perform internal audit/assessment on regular basis based on different business process compliance management and risk control mechanisms in different accounts to ensure the full compliance as per relevant standard and identify potential issues/risks.
  • Work closely with the operation team to get all identified non-compliance items fixed in a timely manner to drive for closure and proactively propose and deploy extra preventive controls where appropriate.
  • Establish and execute a robust methodology for periodic reviews aiming to highlight the gaps that exist in the operational processes.
  • Analyze operational data to identify trends, root causes of business issues, and/or opportunities.
  • Provide recommendations for corrective and preventive actions and suggest improvements to the processes.
  • Review and report the results and present to management team.
  • Ensure partnership with accounts management team for Proactive Compliance Risk Management – identification, assessment, risk action planning, and closures.
  • Coordinate and support Global Security Assessments (GSAs) - a holistic assessment (technology, HR, operations, finance, etc.) of risks being faced by delivery operations and No Notice Inspections (NNIs) conducted against the specific accounts in scope.
  • Participate and involve in assigned investigations.
  • Conduct incidents analytics for assigned areas within the defined timelines.
  • Drive incidents to closure in a timely manner as required.
  • Document learnings from incidents and circulate to relevant stakeholders Work with Client Risk Control Team directly as the security SPOC from CNX.
  • Conduct employee awareness and assist in developing training materials and where necessary assist in specific training.
Accountability
  • Ensure the security and business process compliance in various accounts to meet business and client expectation.
  • Continuously improve the compliance level driven by operational requirement and business growth.
  • Partner/support the country BISO with the completion of various security programs/initiatives in the concerned accounts driven by Insider Risk and Compliance team, including but not limited to the GSA and NNI.
  • Monitor assigned areas of risk ownership ensuring closures are tracked and presented to required stakeholders.
  • Lead and manage the internal review work to achieve the efficiency, effectiveness, and timeliness.
  • Establish governance and cadence as enforced per guidelines.
  • Ensure assigned education sessions are conducted in a timely manner.

title: Open rank professor in Data Science - School of Applied Mathematics at Fundação Getulio Vargas [...]
description:
The School of Applied Mathematics at Fundação Getulio Vargas (FGV EMAp ) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil , invites applications for one open-rank faculty position in Data Science to strengthen and complement our existing research activity in this area.

We are looking for established researchers (associate/full professor) or outstanding young researchers (assistant professor) who have demonstrated research and teaching expertise in Data Science. We will prioritize applicants whose research focuses on natural language processing, computer vision, reinforcement learning, network science and data mining, but we also welcome applications from other fields in Data Science.

The successful candidate is expected to develop an externally funded research programme, publish in high-impact venues, supervise research (postgraduate) students, teach at both undergraduate and graduate levels, and provide service to the department and institution. In general, teaching duties consist of two courses per year, one at Undergraduate and one at Graduate level. Peer-reviewed external funding is expected to be obtained and sustained. Industrial partnerships are also strongly encouraged.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will hold a Ph.D. in Computer Science or a closely related discipline, at the time of the appointment. At the assistant professor level, the applicant is expected to have a compatible track of publications and strong potential for publishing in top ranked venues. At higher levels (associate or full professor) the applicant is expected to have an established line of research with a strong publication record, proven ability to attract external funding, and an established research network.

The successful candidate will also possess excellent communication and presentation skills, being capable of teaching both undergraduate and postgraduate students across our portfolio of Data Science courses. Fluence in Portuguese is desirable, but not required. However, by the end of the second year the applicant may be required to teach in Portuguese.

Start-up package

A generous package is available to provide the necessary resources for starting a successful independent research programme. These include computational infrastructure, lab space as well as postdoctoral positions and support for graduate students. There is also the possibility to apply internally for core-funded projects. During the first year, it will be possible to arrange for a reduced teaching load.

Salary and Benefits

We offer an internationally competitive salaries, higher than any similar academic institution in Brazil. Benefits include health and dental plans, support for young children’s education and private pension fund.

Application

All the application material must be in English. Applicants should send their applications to including:

  1. a cover letter describing their experience, interests, and suitability for the position;
  2. a curriculum vitae (no CV Lattes format);
  3. teaching statement;
  4. research statement;
  5. electronic version (PDF) of their best 3 publications (assistant professor) or best 5 publications (associate or full professor) in the past 5 years. Applications that do not include electronic versions of papers or with more than the required number of papers, will not be considered.

Applicants must also arrange for three reference letters to be sent by the referees in the link . Reference letters must be received before the application deadline .

To be considered at the associate or full professor level, the candidate should also include evidence of experience in directing graduate students.

The deadline for applications is May 31st, 2025.

Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

Job description

A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos, e você terá a oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade?

#VemPraRadix



Main responsibilities

Buscamos pessoas que queiram somar e fazer parte de um ecossistema que leva inovação, tecnologia e soluções para diversos segmentos do mercado. Aqui, os desafios são constantes e você não vai cair na rotina.

Como Profissional de Engenharia de Segurança de Processo, você irá:

  • Elaborar e verificar Listas e Plantas de Classificação de Áreas;
  • Elaborar e verificar Plantas de Segurança, posicionando hidrantes, extintores, canhões-monitores e itens de detecção e alarme, indicando os sistemas de combate de incêndio adequados para cada risco;
  • Dimensionar sistemas de combate a incêndios, realizando análises de cobertura por aspersores, calculando demandas mínimas de água e espuma;
  • Elaborar e verificar balanços hidráulicos usando softwares como PIPE-FLO e Pipenet;
  • Elaborar e verificar Folhas de Dados de equipamentos de prateleira;
  • Elaborar Especificações Técnicas de sistemas customizáveis.

Requirements and skills

Para essa vaga, você deve ter:

  • Conhecimento em softwares como PIPE-FLO e Pipenet;
  • Experiência com sistemas de inundação, dilúvio, water mist e chuveiros automáticos;
  • Conhecimento em Engenharia de fatores Humanos;
  • Estudos de confiabilidade humana e mínimo efetivo.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology - from the kernel through userspace. Apply here if you are an exceptional Go, Rust, or C/C++ software engineer and want to work on next-generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage.
Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure have become essentials of modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro service architecture or cloud infrastructure.
Here are some examples of projects under way at Canonical.
RustVMM has great potential as a new hypervisor for Linux. We are building a team to work on this, with an emphasis on performance, security and operability. Work in Rust and bring your expert knowledge of VMM and related kernel networking and storage capabilities.
Docker images are easy to make and publish on Docker Hub and other registries, but the quality, consistency and security maintenance of those images is broadly very poor. Canonical is in a good position to publish a portfolio of outstanding Docker images. Our Rockcraft team is designing and implementing an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
LXD is a modern system container and virtual machine manager that is widely used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms. LXD engineering spans the entire software stack from low-level kernel work on namespaces, confinement, security, filesystems, VMMs and networking, to the high level management REST API and CLI.
Members of the Kubernetes product team build MicroK8s for on-rails K8s, and Charmed Kubernetes for more sophisticated integration. We work on K8s itself and on the operations tooling around it.
The OpenStack team deliver Charmed OpenStack, OVN / OVS and Ceph. This work brings cloud platform technologies to large-scale computing environments.
These teams hire system level C/C++, Golang, Rust and Python developers to work on security-critical, performance-critical and mission-critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES: Atuar no serviço de suporte de Engenharia a Infraestrutura de Controle e Supervisão, atividades de suporte técnico a hardware e software das camadas de controle, interfaces de operação, protocolos de comunicação com camada de gestão (PIMS), proposição de melhorias na arquitetura de automação existente, elaboração de diagnóstico para solução de problemas em rede de automação e programas aplicativos, e elaboração de Projeto de rede para comunicação de sistemas auxiliares com a sala de controle da planta.
• Prestar atividades de suporte técnico a hardware e software das camadas de controle (PLC´s, DCS/SDCD, conversores de mídia, protocolos de interface com a instrumentação de campo e camada de supervisão) e Supervisão (sistemas SCADA, IHM´s, demais interfaces de operação, protocolos de comunicação com camada de gestão (PIMS));
• Elaborar minuta do Parecer Técnico da aquisição de equipamentos e softwares utilizados na camada de controle e supervisão;
• Realizar deslocamento quando necessário para atendimento e suporte a partir do direcionamento da Gestão imediata;
• Proposição de melhorias na arquitetura de automação existente, visando adequações pertinentes para melhorias referentes a segurança, disponibilidade e confiabilidade da rede e hardware de automação;
• Elaboração de diagnóstico para solução de problemas em rede de automação e programas aplicativos (lógicas e parametrizações de controle) que são executados no hardware da camada de controle e/ou supervisão;
• Elaborar especificação de hardware e softwares específicos e respectivos dispositivos de conectorização para equipamentos (PLC´s, conversores de protocolos, conversores de mídia, softwares controladores, softwares de supervisão, thin clients, etc) utilizados no ambiente de automação industrial;
• Mapear Arquitetura de software e hardware (e identificação de versão dos softwares);
• Avaliar em conjunto com a área de operação, manutenção e gerência para obter suas impressões dos problemas detectados ou deficiências identificadas por eles assim como uma lista de propostas para melhoria segundo necessidade da área;
• Realizar desenvolvimento em softwares de operação e monitoração de processos. Este desenvolvimento consiste em criação de telas, lógicas, servidores de dados, servidores de alarmes, configuração de rede com controladores utilizando protocolos IEC, MODBUS, PROFIBUS, FOUNDATION FIELDBUS, ETHERNET e OPC;
• Apoiar a identificação de problemas nos vários sistemas de automação através de monitoração de variáveis em Controladores Lógicos Programáveis (CLP), Sistema Digital de Controle Distribuído (SDCD), análise de redes de automação e sistemas supervisórios;
• Gerar e implementar soluções de automação para melhorias operacionais através da Implementação de lógicas para CLP’s e SDCD’s;
• Elaborar Memorial Descritivo e Especificação técnica para suporte a contratação de serviços e apoiar em processos de licitações;
• Analisar e verificar logs de falha em servidores OPC e servidores de sistemas supervisórios de 800xA, Elipse E3, Cimplicity, Foxboro IA, WinCC e etc;
• Realizar intervenções nos sistemas de supervisão, controle ou instrumentação;
• Elaborar o plano de ação para solução dos problemas detectados seja internamente ou através de fornecedores externos;
• Implementar e configurar a integração de sistemas de automação utilizando protocolos abertos e proprietários de redes industriais;
• Avaliar solicitações de melhorias dos usuários nas redes de controle e supervisão;
• Configurar OPC servers;
• Identificar sistemas críticos considerando sua obsolescência quanto a Hardware, Software e condições de suporte do fabricante;
• Comissionar serviços contratados junto a fornecedores;
• Elaborar relatórios de testes para suporte ao comissionamento;
• Avaliar e criticar Testes de Aceitação de Fábrica (TAF) junto a fornecedores, realizando análise dos documentos de emitidos e acompanhamento do teste de fábrica para validação do especificado em projeto;
• Revisar telas de operação e manutenção em SDCD’s e IHM’s;
• Elaborar o arquivo de definição de tags para carga em sistema PIMS.;
• Avaliar, criticar e comentar correções em relatórios de comissionamento;
• Assessorar a fiscalização para medição de serviços prestados por fornecedores;
• Apoiar na elaboração de respostas a questionamentos técnicos em circulares de licitações;
• Apoiar a elaboração do cronograma do projeto, levantando possíveis riscos técnicos e seus impactos no projeto em termos de prazo e custos;
• Realizar levantamento de dados do projeto e análise Técnica da Solução, premissas e restrições técnicas do projeto, requisitos operacionais, requisitos de tráfego, requisitos de SMS, segurança da informação, levantamento das necessidades de treinamento, contratos de manutenção, sobressalentes e apoio no desenvolvimento da solução técnica mais adequada para o projeto em termos de prazo, custo e qualidade;
• Apoiar o desenho técnico/topologia da solução do projeto em apoio ao estudo de viabilidade técnica dos projetos, através da documentação de todos os levantamentos realizados na fase conceitual do projeto, descrição do escopo da solução técnica a ser adotada e apresentação de outras considerações técnicas relevantes para a execução do projeto;
• Apoiar as atividades de suprimentos dos projetos com informações técnicas para a elaboração de memoriais descritivos e especificações, apoiar o levantamento de possíveis fornecedores com conhecimento técnico para participação de processo licitatório;
• Garantir que os dados e informações coletados possam assegurar a qualidade do projeto dentro dos parâmetros de compatibilidade entre interfaces internas e externas, clareza no estabelecimento dos requisitos a serem satisfeitos, de forma detalhada;
• Acompanhar e reportar o andamento de todas as atividades técnicas do cronograma do projeto, gerando informações técnicas para as atividades de Monitoramento e Controle como atualização do cronograma, elaboração de Relatórios de Acompanhamento de Projeto (RAP), Solicitações de Mudanças e atualizações de todos os documentos que compõem o Plano de Gerenciamento de Projetos (Plano de Riscos, Plano de Aquisição, EAP e demais planos pertinentes);
• Apoiar a entrega dos sistemas implantados, incluindo a entrega de toda a documentação técnica do sistema (As-Built e outros), garantindo que todos os sistemas do projeto estejam devidamente instalados, configurados, testados e em perfeito funcionamento e operação;
• Participar de reuniões de encerramento do projeto, contribuindo com informações técnica para a confecção do Relatório de Fechamento do Projeto;
• Alinhamento de apoio em campo com as áreas de operação e manutenção, bem como todas as outras áreas interessadas no projeto;

title: Gerente de Projetos/Produtos
description:
Será responsável por liderar o planejamento, a execução e o monitoramento de projetos estratégicos, além de gerenciar o backlog da sustentação do produto e o roadmap com a visão do produto. Atuando como principal ponto de contato entre stakeholders, clientes e a equipe de desenvolvimento, esse profissional assegura que o projeto/produto esteja alinhado com os objetivos de negócio e as necessidades dos clientes. Ele lidera tanto o time multifuncional do projeto cobrindo stakeholders e clientes, tanto quanto a equipe de desenvolvimento, priorizando funcionalidades para maximizar o valor do produto.

  • Definição e Comunicação da Visão do Produto: Estabelecer uma visão clara do produto e comunicar essa visão para a equipe de desenvolvimento e demais stakeholders, garantindo o alinhamento com as metas estratégicas da empresa.
  • Gestão de Backlog e Roadmap com Priorização de Funcionalidades: Manter e priorizar o backlog do produto, definindo funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, viabilidade técnica e necessidades dos usuários.
  • Planejamento e Execução de Projetos: Elaborar cronogramas, alocar recursos e desenvolver planos detalhados para que o projeto seja executado conforme o escopo e dentro do prazo e orçamento definidos.
  • Gerenciamento de Stakeholders e Alinhamento com Clientes: Manter uma comunicação clara e contínua com clientes, fornecedores e equipes internas para garantir que expectativas e requisitos sejam compreendidos e atendidos.
  • Liderança de Equipe: Coordenar equipes multifuncionais, promovendo a colaboração e assegurando que todos os membros estejam alinhados com os objetivos do projeto e do produto.
  • Acompanhamento de Progresso e Qualidade: Monitorar o progresso do projeto e o desenvolvimento do produto, identificando e resolvendo obstáculos para manter a qualidade e o valor das entregas.
  • Definição de Critérios de Aceitação: Estabelecer critérios de aceitação para funcionalidades do produto, garantindo que atendam aos requisitos de qualidade e objetivos de negócios.
  • Gerenciamento de Riscos e Contingências: Identificar, mitigar e gerenciar riscos ao longo do ciclo de vida do projeto e desenvolvimento do produto, adotando planos de contingência quando necessário.
  • Análise e Melhorias Baseadas em Dados: Analisar métricas de desempenho e feedback de usuários para orientar decisões e implementar melhorias no produto e nos processos do projeto.
  • Documentação e Relatórios: Preparar relatórios de status, KPIs e marcos atingidos para a alta gestão e stakeholders, oferecendo transparência sobre o progresso do projeto e a evolução do produto.

About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

11

The Role : The Gen/AI Integration Specialist at S&P Global plays a crucial role in integrating Gen/AI within content creation processes. This role collaborates tightly with content teams to analyze opportunities for AI application, guides the creation of effective prompts, and supports content creators as they transition into an AI-centric workflow. The role also focuses on promoting the use of GenAI and automation tools, within the business workflows and provides training and support on AI and GenAI capabilities for existing and new platforms and services.

The Team:

You will join a highly motivated team scaling innovation and building platforms for our Commodity Insight business lines including news, pricing, research and analytics. We use Agile methodologies to drive ongoing delivery work closely with business and technology partners to share knowledge, embrace change and implement best-of-breed technology.

Responsibilities and Impact:

This role understands in a deep way how the new Gen/AI technologies can be applied to create content, automate workflows, and improve data analysis. This vision, combined with the knowledge of the content creator's internal processes and a desire to create seamless, integrated, efficient and high-value workflows for the business, will drive successful implementation of the new generation of content analysis and creation tools.

  • Collaborate with content creators to identify and implement GenAI solutions, including writing of effective prompts and engaging GenAI to optimize content generation. This may potentially include developing complex prompts to enhance content quality and extract data to feed databases.

  • Champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the company, including to senior leadership, with a focus on positive storytelling.

  • Analyze and optimize key processes by understanding user needs and issues to design efficient and effective business workflows

  • Model and encourage change management practices so that business teams are actively engaged in change, adopt new solutions or ways of working and improve the probability of a successful transition.

  • Lead application training sessions and facilitate additional enterprise Gen/AI trainings to impacted groups.

  • Create relevant, simply and concise training content and process documents that helps colleagues understand changes, tells a compelling story and enables effective sharing of information.

What We’re Looking For:

Basic Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience in crafting prompts for generative AI, with a portfolio of examples ranging from simple to complex scenarios

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, computer science, or a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

  • Strong understanding of natural language processing (NLP) and its application in creating effective AI prompts.

  • Proficiency in a scripting language like Python to facilitate prompt development and testing.

  • Proficient in training and change management to foster technology adoption.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with diverse teams.

  • Proficiency in the English language, writing and speaking.

  • Ability to translate technical AI concepts into practical applications for non-technical teams.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Practical experience with data analysis and AI-driven problem-solving techniques

  • Familiarity with LEAN Six Sigma principles

  • Experience in change initiatives

  • Experience in content creation activities - researching, reporting and content analysis

Right to Work Requirements:

This role is limited to persons with indefinite right to work in the United States / Brazil.

description:
O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino superior completo em: Administração, Gestão Empresarial, Gestão Comercial, Engenharias, Design de Interiores, Arquitetura, ou áreas afins.
  • Desejável pós-graduação cursando ou completa em: Gestão Comercial, Gestão de Pessoas, Marketing, Gestão de Negócios ou áreas afins.
  • Imprescindível experiência gerencial no Varejo.
  • Diferencial experiência com B2B, Pesquisa de concorrentes e de mercado, Visão Comercial / Clientes (cliente/negociação/busca de novidades), Planejamento e acompanhamento de objetivos, domínio de KPI's de vendas (Margem, Ticket Médio, volume de vendas, taxa conversão, rotatividade de estoque, produtos vendidos por categoria, etc).
  • Diferencial conhecimento de Sistemas de Informação (SAP, Power BI, Qlik Sense, Salesforce, etc).
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar aos finais de semana e feriados.

Como é o dia a dia de um(a) Gerente Comercial:

  • Desenvolver e implementar a “Dinâmica Comercial” para a seção, baseada em dados e alinhada com a Oferta de Produtos. Avalia a qualidade da gama de produtos implantada e ajuste a estratégia conforme necessário para melhorar os resultados.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com as áreas de supply, relacionamento e gestão para garantir uma experiência de compra excelente. Monitora a performance das operações comerciais, assegurando a disponibilidade adequada de produtos e envolvendo a equipe em toda a operação.
  • Definir e acompanha os objetivos de margem para suas seções, focando nas linhas que mais impactam os resultados (vendas, MSV, despesas).
  • Negociar com fornecedores, fazendo escolhas estratégicas de produtos, para manter o estoque atualizado com as tendências do mercado.
  • Identificar e atrai novos negócios, usando dados locais para entender melhor o mercado potencial para implementar ações estratégicas para melhorar os resultados.
  • Realizar pesquisas de preços e ofertas de serviços na sua região, colaborando com o HUB de serviços para garantir que sua loja se mantenha competitiva.
  • Gerenciar e otimiza os PDM's dos diferentes negócios (PRO, B2B, E-COMMERCE, SERVIÇOS), sugerindo e testando novas promoções e estratégias para maximizar a rentabilidade e as vendas.
  • Contribuir para o Comitê de Direção da loja, ajudando a definir políticas e prioridades estratégicas e assegurando o cumprimento dos objetivos gerais da loja.
  • Participar da escala de plantão da loja.
  • Representar a empresa frente aos órgãos de proteção ao consumidor ou outros, se necessário, subsidiando e reportando situações e ações junto ao Departamento Jurídico da empresa.

Na LEROY MERLIN, promovemos e incentivamos o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo de comportamentos, conexões e motivadores para que cada pessoa se torne uma verdadeira coach de suas equipes e da sua carreira.

Candidate-se para esta vaga efaça parte da nossa construção!

Desejamos boa sorte no seu processo!

Não deixe de visitar uma loja e conhecer ainda mais sobre como é fazer parte do nosso time, vendo de perto as pessoas que entregam as melhores experiências para nossos clientes.

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.
Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM CCIH, que seja organizado, prático e que tenha uma comunicação assertiva em seus processos de trabalho.
Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Auxiliar o enfermeiro/médico na vigilância das infecções hospitalares, através do método de busca ativa e metodologia da ANVISA nas Unidades de Terapia Intensiva Adulta e Pediátrica, Neonatologia e Infecções do sítio cirúrgico em cesarianas;
  • Auxiliar na realização de investigação epidemiológica de casos e surtos, sempre que indicado;
  • Auxiliar a aplicação de isolamento juntamente com enfermeiro CCIH / médico infectologista;
  • Auxiliar os funcionários da instituição sobre a supervisão do enfermeiro CCIH / médico infectologista, respondendo dúvidas sobre as medidas de controle de infecção hospital;
  • Participar ativamente dos treinamentos dos colaboradores da instituição, promovendo medidas para o controle de infecção hospitalar, bem como, participar das atividades de educação permanente como multiplicador das informações;
  • Observar as conformidades / não conformidades estipuladas pela CCIH para a ação de controle de infecções hospitalares em cada setor da instituição, devendo realizar notificação ao Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente das não conformidades encontradas;
  • Notificar, como membro integrante da equipe de saúde, ao organismo de gestão epidemiológica, os casos diagnosticados ou suspeitos de outras doenças que necessitam de notificação compulsória, atendidos em qualquer setor do hospital, e atuar cooperativamente com os serviços de saúde coletiva, inclusive nas campanhas de vacinação;
  • Participar das reuniões periódicas da CCIH;
  • Realizar as chamadas fonadas para monitoramento das infecções de sítios cirúrgicos em cirurgias limpas.
Esperamos que você tenha:
  • Ensino médio técnico em enfermagem
  • Coren Ativo
  • Dois anos em ambiente hospitalar, preferencialmente em Terapia Intensiva /ccih
  • Pacote office (informática), medidas de precaução, educação em saúde.
Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você:

  • Refeição no Local;
  • Convênio Médico ;

Nosso objetivo é colocar a indústria no centro dos novos desafios enfrentados pela nossa sociedade.

Fazemos parte do Groupe SNEF, uma multinacional francesa que entrega soluções multidisciplinares nas áreas de Energia, Infraestrutura e Indústria. Realizar análise de requisitos técnicos dos clientes para sistemas de telecomunicações, compreendendo as necessidades específicas e o escopo dos projetos;

Conduzir análise de custo-benefício das soluções técnicas, avaliando alternativas que ofereçam o melhor equilíbrio entre desempenho e investimento;

Elaborar descritivos técnicos detalhados das soluções para os sistemas de telecomunicações, garantindo clareza e precisão nas especificações apresentadas.

Análise de custo-benefício das soluções técnicas e elaboração de descritivotécnico da solução dos sistemas de Telecomunicações
